mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high housing starts (HOUST > 1400 thousand units), strong residential construction activity signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1400 but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate indicates a tighter labor market that supports higher corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1400 but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
